topic: Day 47 — reel — Trust usually erodes through small inconsistencies, not one big betrayal
text: Small gaps corrode more than one big [betrayal].
caption:
People rarely lose trust all at once. They lose it gradually, through a pattern of minor gaps.

Follow for one of these a day.
